findings.title: The plot map shows free and taken plots, not the waiting list or the offer to the next person

location.description: the plot map next to the headline, starting at its title

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer sees which plots are free, but nothing shows the step only Plotwise does, offering a free plot to the next person on the waiting list. The one picture on the page backs up keeping the plots, not the headline's promise.

current.value: the map shows only free or taken for each plot

findings.target: the map shows a free plot going to the next person on the waiting list
findings.fix_direction: Show a free plot going to the next person on the list, for example a short waiting list beside the map with plot 3 marked as offered to the first person on it. Use only states and names the product really has; the maker must supply them.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images that the plot map or the area beside it shows a free plot offered to the next person on a waiting list

findings.title: The plot map card ends short of the right edge that the nav and the cards share

location.description: the plot map card in the hero, right side

findings.viewer_experience: The hero's right side looks ragged against the rows above and below it.

current.value: card ends at x 1106 on desktop (x 1426 on widescreen), 110 px short of x 1216 (x 1536)

findings.target: the card ends at the content's right edge, or at the third card column's right edge (x 925 on desktop)
findings.fix_direction: Widen the card to the content's right edge, or end it on the third card column's right edge.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees in the desktop and widescreen images that the plot map card's right edge lines up with the nav and the card columns

findings.title: The March reminder and the week to say yes read as fixed product limits

location.description: the copy in the rent reminders card and the plot offers card

findings.viewer_experience: The copy reads as fixed rules, though they may be examples.

current.value: copy states one reminder before rent is due in March and a week to say yes as plain facts

findings.target: the card copy marks each as an example or a rule
findings.fix_direction: The maker must say whether they are examples or rules, then mark them that way in the card copy.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees in all four viewports that the card copy marks the March reminder and the week to say yes as examples or as rules

findings.title: "What Plotwise does" could head any product's page

location.description: the section heading above the four feature cards

findings.viewer_experience: The heading says nothing specific, and its larger size draws more attention to it.
findings.target: a heading that names what the four cards hold
findings.fix_direction: Reword it, using words already on the page, so it names what the four cards hold.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees in all four viewports a section heading that names what the four cards hold
